mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.venue_id, v.name AS venue_name, e.name AS employee_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rp.permission_code ORDER BY rp.permission_code) AS permissions FROM s_employee e JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = e.venue_id LEFT JOIN s_employee_role er ON er.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN s_venue_role r ON r.id = er.role_id AND r.venue_id = e.venue_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN s_venue_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY e.id, e.venue_id, v.name, e.name ORDER BY v.name, e.id
